batch: Windows port of playtest build 115, first all-green Windows packaged sweep
source_commit: 6bc49d1 on piedmont-ride-v2 (Windows-port changes committed on windows-port)
verified_against: packaged Windows Development build 115, exe under Windows/AuraPlayground/Binaries/Win64/AuraPlayground.exe

windows_port_fixes.what: No admin rights to install the 4.6.2 targeting pack, so HKCU Software/Microsoft/Microsoft SDKs/NETFXSDK/4.6.2 points at a local KitsInstallationFolder with the um include and lib files. Any fresh Windows machine needs the same shim or the Dev Pack.

windows_port_fixes.fix: MSVC shadow-variable warnings down to Warning level
windows_port_fixes.what: AuraPlayground.Target.cs and AuraPlaygroundEditor.Target.cs set ShadowVariableWarningLevel=WarningLevel.Warning and bOverrideBuildEnvironment=true so MSVC compiles the codebase the way clang already did on Mac.
MSVC flagged a float/double narrowing where clang did not; the audit code is unchanged in behavior.
The Editor-only Aura plugin does not exist on Windows and blocked the editor. Gameplay is unaffected; the Mac project keeps its own copy.

Now cooks CitySampleCrowd, BattleRetarget, EuropeanHornbeam, BattleForTheA/Spirit and BattleForTheA/Environment/KrogIncident alongside the PiedmontWorld map so the packaged build carries every asset the audits exercise.
The template files use curly quotes; the script now decodes utf-8 instead of the Windows default code page.

missing_content_recovered.round_1: BattleOfATL-missing-content-2026-09-18.zip: crowd body meshes (m_tal_nrw_body, f_tal_nrw_body), Shared/Rig control rigs, Mannequins, SK_SportsCar
missing_content_recovered.round_2: BattleOfATL-windows-content-2-2026-09-18.zip: Content/EuropeanHornbeam (park trees), full Content/CitySampleCrowd (clothing, faces, hair, loco anims), Content/BattleRetarget/City recovery clips, Spirit texture and material, Krog scooter materials
missing_content_recovered.first_windows_sweep: 11/16 green; the 5 failures (Curse, both TreeRide variants, Sleeper, Spirit) were all traced to these missing Mac-only assets, none to code.

content_not_in_git: Content/EuropeanHornbeam and Content/CitySampleCrowd are too large for GitHub (individual textures over 200 MB) and travel by Drive zip instead. They are recorded here so a fresh clone knows to fetch BattleOfATL-windows-content-2-2026-09-18.zip.
settings_untouched: No settings menu, option list or saved-settings code was edited on Windows; gameplay source is identical to Mac build 115 apart from the compiler-level fixes above.
verification_debt: The share folder stub exe at the top level was smoke-tested with BattleDuckAudit from the renamed The Battle of ATL.exe and passes; the full sweep ran from the real exe in Windows/AuraPlayground/Binaries/Win64.

delivery.github_push: blocked: Mac history contains Content/CitySampleCrowd/Character/Male/NormalWeight/Textures/blazer/T_m_nrw_blazer_BN.uasset at 222 MB, over GitHub 100 MB per-file limit (pre-receive GH001). The Windows branch commit is complete locally; GitHub needs Git LFS or a history cleanup on the Mac side.
